summary: PIM Manager is ready to replace v1, managing Azure resource policies and the full admin lifecycle.

new.title: Azure resource PIM policies are managed
new.text: Durations, MFA, justification, notifications and approval come from your policy templates. Approval that is already on is never removed.

new.title: A safety brake on policy changes
new.text: A run that would change many policies or weaken protection changes nothing and shows the plan for approval in Jobs, Engine logs & errors.

new.title: Full admin lifecycle
new.text: Admin accounts are created when due and kept in step. Offboarding runs on its own schedule, and disabled admins stay disabled.

new.title: Workload roles applied
new.text: Defender, Intune, enterprise application, Power BI, Power Platform, Business Central, Azure DevOps and Azure roles in your data are applied, with exemptions.

fixes.title: Your changes are carried out
fixes.text: Removals, eligible and active switches, duration changes and auto-extend are applied. Bulk removals are held for review.

fixes.title: Manager needs its database to start
fixes.text: Settings, access and templates now live only in the database, and templates upgrade automatically when unchanged.
fixes.action: Make sure the Manager can reach its database before updating, as it no longer starts without it.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Temporary Access Passes respect a start date, reminders and reports have real content, Pending changes shows real names, and audit times are correct.
